name: ender3v2-klipper
description: Migrate a Creality Ender 3 V2 (board 4.2.2, CR Touch) from Marlin to mainline Klipper on a Raspberry Pi, a Linux PC or an Apple Silicon Mac (headless Debian VM with the USB serial bridged over TCP), with a full calibration, a go/no-go gate, print monitoring and power-loss resume.
